```{=html}
<!-- Return-State Behavior Profile workbench (shared by the EN and ZH pages; language from <html lang>).
     Every control selects one of 21 results computed at build time by pipeline/exhibits/return_state.py
     (7 streams x 3 state definitions, full sample) from the archived records; /data/return_state.json holds
     aggregates only. Half-sample windows are not published: they failed the pipeline's disclosure screen. Without JavaScript the whole workbench stays hidden (the script unhides it first thing); each page carries its own <noscript> image and the build-time table. -->
<style>
/* Metric panel: the question, one plain reading and how far to trust it; the definition sits in a collapsed <details>. */
#rs-detail .rs-q { margin: 0 0 .3rem; color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; }
html[lang^="zh"] #rs-detail .rs-q { font-style: normal; }
#rs-detail .rs-read { margin: 0 0 .3rem; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--fg); }
#rs-detail .rs-trust { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); }
#rs-detail .rs-trust strong { color: var(--wb-warn-fg); font-weight: 600; }
#rs-detail details.rs-more { margin: .5rem 0 0; padding-top: .35rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
#rs-detail details.rs-more > summary { cursor: pointer; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); padding: 2px 0; min-height: 24px; width: max-content; max-width: 100%; }
#rs-detail details.rs-more > summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }
#rs-detail details.rs-more[open] > summary { margin-bottom: .35rem; }
#rs-detail details.rs-more dl { align-items: baseline; }
#rs-detail details.rs-more dt { margin: 0; }   /* the theme gives dt a 1em top margin, which pushed each label below its value */
@media (max-width: 599.98px) { #rs-detail details.rs-more dt { margin-top: 6px; } }
</style>
<div id="rs-app" class="rs-app" data-src="/data/return_state.json" hidden>
  <form class="rs-controls" id="rs-controls" hidden onsubmit="return false">
    <div class="rs-ctl"><label for="rs-stream" id="rs-l-stream">Return stream</label><select id="rs-stream"></select></div>
    <div class="rs-ctl"><label for="rs-def" id="rs-l-def">State definition</label><select id="rs-def"></select></div>
    <fieldset class="rs-ctl rs-mode"><legend id="rs-l-mode">Display</legend>
      <div class="rs-seg">
        <label><input type="radio" name="rs-mode" id="rs-mode-norm" value="norm" checked><span id="rs-l-norm">Normalised</span></label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="rs-mode" id="rs-mode-raw" value="raw"><span id="rs-l-raw">Raw values</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>
  </form>
  <div class="rs-dataline" id="rs-dataline"></div>
  <div class="rs-warn" id="rs-warn" role="status"></div>
  <div class="rs-grid">
    <div>
      <div class="rs-chart" id="rs-chart"></div>
      <div class="rs-legend" id="rs-legend"></div>
      <p class="rs-key" id="rs-key" hidden></p>
      <p class="rs-key" id="rs-hintline"></p>
    </div>
    <div class="rs-side">
      <div class="rs-detail" id="rs-detail" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="rs-summary" id="rs-summary"></p>
  <p class="tbl-note" id="rs-table-cap"></p>
  <div class="table-scroll" id="rs-table-host"></div>
  <div class="rs-tools" id="rs-tools" hidden>
    <button type="button" id="rs-csv">Download this view (CSV)</button>
    <a href="/data/return_state.json" id="rs-json">All 21 results (JSON, aggregates only)</a>
    <span class="rs-status" id="rs-status"></span>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  root.hidden = false;  // shown only when this script runs; a failed load still needs it for the message and fallback image
  var LANG = (document.documentElement.lang || "en").indexOf("zh") === 0 ? "zh" : "en";
  var T = {
    en: {
      stream: "Return stream", def: "State definition", win: "Sample window", mode: "Display",
      norm: "Normalised", raw: "Raw values", csv: "Download this view (CSV)",
      json: "All 21 results (JSON, aggregates only)",
      data: "Data: archived backtest (not actual trading, not audited), monthly, Apr 2007 – Nov 2025",
      dataPublic: "Data: public market and Treasury-bill returns, monthly, Apr 2007 – Nov 2025",
      built: "Computed at build time from the archived records: ",
      window: "Window: ", months: " months",
      bench: "U.S. equity benchmark", solid: " (solid line, filled dots)", dashed: " (dashed line, open dots)",
      metric: "Metric", state: "Market state (n)", score: "Score", rawv: "Raw", units: "Units", ci: "95% interval",
      clipped: " (clipped)", byCon: " (set by the state definition)",
      mkClip: "hollow square: score clipped at 0 or 1", mkCon: "grey diamond: benchmark value set by the state definition",
      key: "Spokes: ", refRow: "All months (reference)",
      pct: "% a month", beta: "slope", freq: "share of months positive",
      caption: function (s, d, w) { return s + " against the U.S. equity benchmark · " + d + " · " + w; },
      warnSmall: function (st, n, lim) { return st + ": n = " + n + " months (below " + lim + "). Small sample: read as a description of these months, not as evidence about future ones."; },
      warnNone: "No state in this view has fewer than ", warnNone2: " months; the radar is still descriptive only.",
      warnBench: "The benchmark defines the states, so on spokes 4–8 its values are fixed or bounded by construction: beta 1, no positive months and a mean below the state's cut-off. Read them as reference points, not as a contest.",
      warnLS: "The example strategy is long–short (about +1 long, −1 short); the benchmark is long-only. Its full-sample beta on the benchmark is close to 0.",
      warnClip: function (k) { return k + " of the 16 scores in this view are clipped at 0 or 1 (marked “clipped” in the table); compare the raw values."; },
      warnSelect: "Selection: this configuration was the best among several compared in an earlier study by the author; the selection bias is not corrected.",
      warnLoad: "The signal applies one fixed set of loadings to every formation month; their estimation sample is not documented here and may overlap the backtest, so do not read the stream as an out-of-sample result.",
      warnStable: "Stability: the archived strategy's downside profile differs markedly between the two halves of the sample (half-sample results are withheld for disclosure), so do not read the full-sample profile as a stable trait.",
      warnDilute: "Dilution-only reference: the 60/40 proxy funded pro rata into cash, with no strategy (equity 57% or 54%). Compare it with the matching strategy sleeve.",
      warnOverlap: function (k) { return "States overlap: every tail month is also a downside month; " + k + " strong-rally months are also recovery months."; },
      warnProxy: "The 60/40 proxy is 60% U.S. equity + 40% cash (one-month bills), not a stock–bond portfolio.",
      warnGross: "Gross stream: before the bid-ask cost proxy, so not comparable with net figures.",
      warnSleeve: "The sleeve blends the proxy and the net strategy stream with fixed weights rebalanced monthly; the long–short return is treated as the return on the sleeve's capital, with no financing, margin or blend-rebalancing costs. It is funded pro rata, so equity falls to 57% (5% sleeve) or 54% (10%): compare with the matching cash reference to separate dilution from the strategy effect. Not an allocation recommendation.",
      pos: function (k, n) { return k + " of " + n + " months positive"; },
      summary: function (v) { return "Text summary of this view. In the " + v.nd + " downside months the stream’s mean return was " + v.dr + " a month (benchmark " + v.bdr + "), " + v.dk + " of " + v.nd + " months positive, downside beta " + v.db + " (95% interval " + v.dbci + "). In the " + v.nt + " tail months: " + v.tr + " a month (95% interval " + v.trci + "; benchmark " + v.btr + "), " + v.tk + " of " + v.nt + " positive. In the " + v.nn + " normal months: " + v.cr + " a month (benchmark " + v.bcr + "). Over all " + v.na + " months: " + v.ar + " a month. Historical and descriptive; not a forecast."; },
      radarTitle: "Return-State radar: normalised scores, 0 at the centre, 1 at the rim",
      rawTitle: "Raw values by metric, on each unit’s own axis",
      gRet: "Mean monthly return in the state (%)", gBeta: "Downside beta (slope on the benchmark)", gFreq: "Months with a positive return (%)",
      failed: "The interactive data did not load. The static image and the build-time table below show the default view.",
      csvDone: "CSV downloaded.", na: "n/a", small: "small n",
      hint: "Hover over, tap or focus a spoke (or a table row) to read that metric; arrow keys move between spokes."
    },
    zh: {
      stream: "收益序列", def: "状态定义", win: "样本窗口", mode: "显示方式",
      norm: "标准化得分", raw: "原始数值", csv: "下载当前视图（CSV）",
      json: "全部 21 组结果（JSON，仅汇总统计）",
      data: "数据：存档回测（不是实际交易，未经审计），月度，2007 年 4 月至 2025 年 11 月",
      dataPublic: "数据：公开的市场收益与国库券收益，月度，2007 年 4 月至 2025 年 11 月",
      built: "构建网站时由存档记录计算：",
      window: "窗口：", months: " 个月",
      bench: "美国股票基准", solid: "（实线，实心点）", dashed: "（虚线，空心点）",
      metric: "指标", state: "市场状态（月数）", score: "得分", rawv: "原始值", units: "单位", ci: "95% 区间",
      clipped: "（截断）", byCon: "（由状态定义决定）",
      mkClip: "空心方块：得分被截断为 0 或 1", mkCon: "灰色菱形：基准数值由状态定义决定",
      key: "辐射轴：", refRow: "全部月份（参照）",
      pct: "月收益 %", beta: "斜率", freq: "正收益月份占比",
      caption: function (s, d, w) { return s + " 与美国股票基准对比 · " + d + " · " + w; },
      warnSmall: function (st, n, lim) { return st + "：n = " + n + " 个月（少于 " + lim + "）。样本很小：只描述这些月份，不能据此推断未来。"; },
      warnNone: "本视图中没有少于 ", warnNone2: " 个月的状态；雷达图仍只作描述。",
      warnBench: "市场状态由基准定义，因此基准在第 4–8 轴上的数值由构造决定或限定：贝塔为 1、没有正收益月份、平均收益低于该状态的阈值。这些只是参照点，不是比较输赢。",
      warnLS: "示例策略为多空组合（多头约 +1、空头约 −1），基准为纯多头；该策略在全样本上对基准的贝塔接近 0。",
      warnClip: function (k) { return "本视图 16 个得分中有 " + k + " 个被截断为 0 或 1（表中标“截断”），请比较原始数值。"; },
      warnSelect: "选择偏差：这一配置是作者在更早的研究中从多个候选方案里选出的最佳方案；选择偏差未作校正。",
      warnLoad: "信号对每个建仓月都使用同一组固定载荷；本页没有记录这组载荷的估计样本，它可能与回测期重叠，因此不要把这条序列当作样本外结果。",
      warnStable: "稳定性：存档策略在前后两个半样本中的下行表现明显不同（出于披露限制，半样本结果不公开），因此不要把全样本画像当作稳定特征。",
      warnDilute: "只稀释的参照序列：60/40 代理组合按比例让出资金给现金，不含策略（股票占 57% 或 54%）。请与对应的策略配置对照。",
      warnOverlap: function (k) { return "状态可以重叠：尾部月份都属于下行月份；" + k + " 个强势上涨月份同时是修复月份。"; },
      warnProxy: "60/40 代理组合指 60% 美国股票 + 40% 现金（一个月期国债），不是股债组合。",
      warnGross: "毛收益序列：未扣买卖价差成本代理，不能与净收益直接比较。",
      warnSleeve: "该配置按固定权重混合代理组合与策略净收益，每月再平衡；多空收益被当作这部分资金本身的收益，不计融资、保证金或再平衡成本。资金按比例划出，股票比例因此降到 57%（5% 配置）或 54%（10%）：与对应的现金参照序列对照，才能区分“少持股票”与策略本身的影响。不是配置建议。",
      pos: function (k, n) { return n + " 个月中 " + k + " 个月为正"; },
      summary: function (v) { return "本视图文字摘要：在 " + v.nd + " 个下行月份中，收益序列的平均月收益为 " + v.dr + "（基准 " + v.bdr + "），" + v.nd + " 个月中 " + v.dk + " 个月为正，下行贝塔 " + v.db + "（95% 区间 " + v.dbci + "）。在 " + v.nt + " 个尾部月份中：平均月收益 " + v.tr + "（95% 区间 " + v.trci + "；基准 " + v.btr + "），" + v.nt + " 个月中 " + v.tk + " 个月为正。在 " + v.nn + " 个常态月份中：平均月收益 " + v.cr + "（基准 " + v.bcr + "）。全部 " + v.na + " 个月：平均月收益 " + v.ar + "。以上为历史描述，不是预测。"; },
      radarTitle: "收益状态雷达图：标准化得分，中心为 0，外圈为 1",
      rawTitle: "各指标原始数值，每类单位各用一条数轴",
      gRet: "该状态下的平均月收益（%）", gBeta: "下行贝塔（对基准的斜率）", gFreq: "收益为正的月份占比（%）",
      failed: "交互数据未能加载。下方的静态图和构建时表格显示默认视图。",
      csvDone: "已下载 CSV。", na: "无", small: "样本小",
      hint: "将鼠标悬停在某条辐射轴（或表格中的一行）上、轻触或用键盘聚焦，即可查看该指标的解读；方向键可在各轴之间移动。"
    }
  }[LANG];

  var C = LANG === "zh" ? "：" : ": ";   // label separator
  var el = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  (function () {   // the table is created here: a <table> inside a raw HTML block upsets Quarto's table parser
    var t = document.createElement("table");
    t.className = "tbl-num rs-table"; t.id = "rs-table";
    el("rs-table-host").appendChild(t);
  })();
  var NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  var D = null;
  var cur = { stream: null, def: null, win: null, mode: "norm", active: 0, more: false };

  function minus(s) { return String(s).replace(/-/g, "−"); }
  function pct(v, dp) { return v == null ? T.na : minus((v * 100).toFixed(dp == null ? 2 : dp) + "%"); }
  function fmt(units, v, k, n) {
    if (v == null) return T.na;
    if (units === "pct_month") return pct(v, 2);
    if (units === "beta") return minus(v.toFixed(2));
    if (k != null) return LANG === "zh" ? (k + "/" + n + "（" + (v * 100).toFixed(1) + "%）") : (k + "/" + n + " (" + (v * 100).toFixed(1) + "%)");
    return pct(v, 1);
  }
  function ival(units, ci) {
    if (!ci || ci[0] == null || ci[1] == null) return T.na;
    var sep = LANG === "zh" ? " 至 " : " to ";
    if (units === "pct_month") return pct(ci[0], 2) + sep + pct(ci[1], 2);
    if (units === "beta") return minus(ci[0].toFixed(2)) + sep + minus(ci[1].toFixed(2));
    return (ci[0] * 100).toFixed(1) + "%" + sep + (ci[1] * 100).toFixed(1) + "%";
  }
  function txt(o) { return o ? (o[LANG] || o.en) : ""; }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; }); }
  function longDate(iso) {
    var d = new Date(iso);
    if (isNaN(d)) return iso;
    var m = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
    return LANG === "zh" ? (d.getUTCFullYear() + " 年 " + (d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + " 月 " + d.getUTCDate() + " 日")
                         : (d.getUTCDate() + " " + m[d.getUTCMonth()] + " " + d.getUTCFullYear());
  }

  /* rs-panel:begin
     Metric panel (EN and ZH). Visible: the metric's name, the question it answers for a portfolio manager,
     one plain reading of the selected stream's history (against the benchmark where that means something)
     and one line on how far to trust it: the months behind it, the 95% interval in plain words and a
     small-sample warning below meta.small_n. Everything else (state rule, calculation, standard error,
     normalised score and formula, clipping, benchmark set by the state definition, white-paper name, how
     the reading is worded) sits in a collapsed native <details>, which the keyboard can open.
     The wording is data: PANEL, between the rs-panel-text markers, is valid JSON with {placeholder}
     templates, and every number in a reading is filled from return_state.json. The block is pure (no DOM,
     no page globals): pipeline/tests/test_return_state.py reads PANEL as JSON, checks every reading of the
     21 results x 8 metrics x 2 languages against the JSON, and runs this block under JavaScriptCore where
     available to confirm the browser builds the same strings. */
  var PANEL = /* rs-panel-text:begin */ {
    "bands": { "flat": 0.001, "half": 0.5, "near": [0.9, 1.1], "beta": [-0.25, 0.25, 0.75, 1.25] },
    "en": {
      "q": {
        "carry": "In ordinary months, away from the market's biggest moves, what did this stream earn?",
        "upside": "When the market rallied hard, how much of the gain did this stream capture?",
        "recovery": "When the market rebounded from a drawdown, how much of the rebound did this stream capture?",
        "downside_beta": "When the market fell, how closely did this stream move with it?",
        "downside_reactivity": "When the market sold off, did this stream make or lose money?",
        "downside_reliability": "In the market's sell-off months, how often did this stream still finish positive?",
        "tail_reactivity": "In the market's very worst months, did this stream make or lose money?",
        "tail_reliability": "In the market's very worst months, how often did this stream still finish positive?"
      },
      "where": {
        "normal": "In ordinary months (the market's middle {p}%)",
        "rally": "In the market's strongest months (top {p}%)",
        "recovery": "In recovery months (the market climbing back from a drawdown deeper than {p}%)",
        "downside": "In the market's worst months (bottom {p}%)",
        "tail": "In the market's very worst months (bottom {p}%)"
      },
      "ret": "{where}, the stream averaged {s} a month and the market {b}: {verdict}.",
      "beta": "{where}, the stream's downside beta was {s} (the market's own is {b}): {verdict}.",
      "freq": {
        "some": "{where}, the stream still finished positive in {k} of the {n} months ({share}); {mk}.",
        "none": "{where}, the stream finished positive in none of the {n} months; {mk}.",
        "all": "{where}, the stream finished positive in all {n} months; {mk}."
      },
      "mk": { "con0": "the market, by definition, in none", "none": "the market in none", "some": "the market in {kb}" },
      "verdict": {
        "carry": { "loss": "it lost money on average", "flat": "it was roughly flat", "below": "it earned less than the market",
                   "same": "it earned about as much as the market", "above": "it earned more than the market",
                   "gain": "it made money on average" },
        "upside": { "loss": "it lost money while the market rallied", "flat": "it was roughly flat while the market rallied",
                    "lt_half": "it captured less than half of the market's gain",
                    "gt_half": "it captured more than half of the market's gain, but not all of it",
                    "same": "it rose about as much as the market", "more": "it rose more than the market",
                    "gain": "it rose on average" },
        "recovery": { "loss": "it lost money while the market rebounded", "flat": "it was roughly flat while the market rebounded",
                      "lt_half": "it captured less than half of the market's rebound",
                      "gt_half": "it captured more than half of the market's rebound, but not all of it",
                      "same": "it rebounded about as much as the market", "more": "it rose more than the market",
                      "gain": "it rose on average" },
        "down": { "gain": "it made money on average while the market fell", "flat": "it was roughly flat while the market fell",
                  "lt_half": "it lost money too, but less than half as much as the market",
                  "less": "it lost money too, but less than the market", "same": "it lost about as much as the market",
                  "more": "it lost more than the market", "loss": "it lost money on average" },
        "beta": { "against": "it tended to move against the market", "little": "it moved little with the market",
                  "partial": "it moved with the market, but less than one for one",
                  "one": "it moved roughly one for one with the market",
                  "more": "it moved more than one for one with the market" }
      },
      "noval": "No value is available in this view.",
      "lead": { "based": "Based on {n} months.",
                "small": "Only {n} months (fewer than {lim}): a small sample, too few to treat as a dependable trait." },
      "sep": " ",
      "iv": "The {lvl}% interval ({range}) {it}.",
      "noiv": "No interval is available for this value.",
      "range": { "pct_month": "{lo} to {hi} a month", "beta": "{lo} to {hi}", "freq": "{lo} to {hi}" },
      "it": {
        "above0": "lies entirely above zero", "below0": "lies entirely below zero",
        "spans0": "spans zero, so even the sign is uncertain",
        "aboveHalf": "lies entirely above {half}: more often positive than not, even at its low end",
        "belowHalf": "lies entirely below {half}: positive in fewer than half of the months, even at its high end",
        "spansHalf": "includes {half}, so a coin flip cannot be ruled out",
        "both": "includes both 0 and 1: too wide to say how closely it moved with the market",
        "has0": "includes 0 but not 1: consistent with no link to the market, not with a one-for-one move",
        "has1": "includes 1 but not 0: consistent with a one-for-one move, not with no link to the market",
        "mid": "lies entirely between 0 and 1: tied to the market, but less than one for one",
        "neg": "lies entirely below 0: it tended to move against the market",
        "gt1": "lies entirely above 1: more than one for one"
      },
      "more": "Definition and calculation",
      "dStream": "Stream", "dBench": "Benchmark", "dState": "State rule", "dN": "Observations", "dCalc": "Calculation",
      "dCi": "{lvl}% interval (stream)", "dNorm": "Normalised score (stream / benchmark)",
      "aMonth": " a month", "se": "standard error", "bench": "U.S. equity benchmark", "smallTag": "small n",
      "na": "n/a", "colon": ": ", "open": " (", "close": ")", "clipped": " (clipped)",
      "count": "{k}/{n} ({share})", "nOf": "{n} of the window’s {m} months",
      "calc": {
        "ret": "Mean monthly return of the stream over the state’s months.",
        "beta": "OLS slope of the stream on the benchmark over the downside months: cov(stream, benchmark) / var(benchmark), ddof = 1.",
        "freq": "Share of the state’s months in which the stream’s return was above zero: a historical hit frequency, not a probability."
      },
      "ciNote": "Months treated as independent; descriptive only. A wide interval means the history cannot pin the value down.",
      "conNote": "The benchmark's value on this spoke is fixed or bounded by the state definition, so it marks the cut-off, not a performance comparison.",
      "clipNote": "A clipped score hides how far the raw value lies beyond the scale: compare the raw values.",

  function rsView(D, stream, def, win) {   // one of the 21 precomputed results, with its state table and labels
    var by = function (list, id) { for (var j = 0; j < list.length; j++) if (list[j].id === id) return list[j]; return null; };
    var k = def + "|" + win, st = D.states[k];
    return { key: stream + "|" + k, st: st, res: D.results[stream + "|" + k], bench: st.bench,
             stream: by(D.streams, stream), def: by(D.definitions, def), win: by(D.windows, win) };
  }
  function rsFill(t, o) {   // "{name}" -> o.name; an unknown name stays visible (the tests look for "{")
    return String(t).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, function (all, k) { return o[k] == null ? all : String(o[k]); });
  }
  function rsPanel(L, D, v, i, open) {
    var P = PANEL[L], B = PANEL.bands, m = D.metrics[i], st = m.state, u = m.units, d = v.def;
    var n = v.st.n[st], lim = D.meta.small_n, small = n < lim, lvl = String(Math.round(D.meta.ci_level * 100));
    var s = v.res.raw[i], b = v.bench.raw[i], ci = v.res.ci[i] || [null, null], se = v.res.se[i];
    var k = u === "freq" ? v.res.pos[st] : null, kb = u === "freq" ? v.bench.pos[st] : null;
    var tx = function (o) { return o ? (o[L] || o.en) : ""; };
    var esc = function (x) { return String(x).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; }); };
    var fx = function (x, dp) { var t = x.toFixed(dp); return /^-0(\.0+)?$/.test(t) ? t.slice(1) : t; };   // never "−0.00"
    var mn = function (t) { return String(t).replace(/-/g, "−"); };
    var pc = function (x, dp) { return x == null ? P.na : mn(fx(x * 100, dp == null ? 2 : dp) + "%"); };
    var sp = function (x) { var t = pc(x); return x != null && x > 0 && t !== "0.00%" ? "+" + t : t; };   // signed, for the reading
    var bt = function (x) { return x == null ? P.na : mn(fx(x, 2)); };
    var f = function (x) { return u === "beta" ? bt(x) : pc(x, u === "freq" ? 1 : 2); };
    // The state's share of the market's months, from the definition's cut-offs ("bottom 10%").
    var pp = Math.round(100 * (st === "normal" ? d.upper - d.lower : st === "rally" ? 1 - d.upper :
                               st === "recovery" ? -d.recovery_dd : st === "tail" ? d.tail : d.lower));
    var where = rsFill(P.where[st], { p: pp });
    // 1. One plain reading of the history; the verdict comes from fixed bands (worded in the definition block).
    var code, read;
    if (u === "freq") {
      code = k == null ? "na" : k === 0 ? "none" : k === n ? "all" : "some";
      var mk = kb === 0 ? (m.bench_by_construction ? "con0" : "none") : "some";
      read = code === "na" ? P.noval : rsFill(P.freq[code], { where: where, k: k, n: n, share: pc(s, 1), mk: rsFill(P.mk[mk], { kb: kb }) });
    } else if (u === "beta") {
      code = s == null ? "na" : s <= B.beta[0] ? "against" : s < B.beta[1] ? "little" : s < B.beta[2] ? "partial" : s <= B.beta[3] ? "one" : "more";
      read = code === "na" ? P.noval : rsFill(P.beta, { where: where, s: bt(s), b: bt(b), verdict: P.verdict.beta[code] });
    } else {
      var grp = m.id === "carry" || m.id === "upside" || m.id === "recovery" ? m.id : "down";
      var r = s != null && b ? s / b : null;
      if (s == null) code = "na";
      else if (grp === "down")   // the market's mean is negative here: r is the stream's loss as a share of the market's
        code = s >= B.flat ? "gain" : s > -B.flat ? "flat" : !(b < 0) ? "loss" :
               r < B.half ? "lt_half" : r < B.near[0] ? "less" : r <= B.near[1] ? "same" : "more";
      else                       // the market's mean is positive here: r is the stream's gain as a share of the market's
        code = s <= -B.flat ? "loss" : s < B.flat ? "flat" : !(b > 0) ? "gain" :
               grp === "carry" ? (r < B.near[0] ? "below" : r <= B.near[1] ? "same" : "above") :
               (r < B.half ? "lt_half" : r < B.near[0] ? "gt_half" : r <= B.near[1] ? "same" : "more");
      read = code === "na" ? P.noval : rsFill(P.ret, { where: where, s: sp(s), b: sp(b), verdict: P.verdict[grp][code] });
    }
    // 2. How far to trust it: the months behind it and the 95% interval in plain words.
    var lo = ci[0], hi = ci[1], ic;
    if (lo == null || hi == null) ic = "na";
    else if (u === "pct_month") ic = lo > 0 ? "above0" : hi < 0 ? "below0" : "spans0";
    else if (u === "freq") ic = lo > B.half ? "aboveHalf" : hi < B.half ? "belowHalf" : "spansHalf";
    else {
      var c0 = lo <= 0 && hi >= 0, c1 = lo <= 1 && hi >= 1;
      ic = c0 && c1 ? "both" : c0 ? "has0" : c1 ? "has1" : hi < 0 ? "neg" : lo > 1 ? "gt1" : "mid";
    }
    var lead = rsFill(small ? P.lead.small : P.lead.based, { n: n, lim: lim });
    var range = ic === "na" ? P.na : rsFill(P.range[u], { lo: f(lo), hi: f(hi) });
    var rest = ic === "na" ? P.noiv : rsFill(P.iv, { lvl: lvl, range: range, it: rsFill(P.it[ic], { half: pc(B.half, 0) }) });
    var trust = lead + P.sep + rest;
    var h = "<h4>" + (i + 1) + ". " + esc(tx(m)) + "</h4>";
    h += '<p class="rs-q">' + esc(P.q[m.id]) + "</p>";
    h += '<p class="rs-read">' + esc(read) + "</p>";
    h += '<p class="rs-trust">' + (small ? "<strong>" + esc(lead) + "</strong>" : esc(lead)) + esc(P.sep + rest) + "</p>";
    // 3. Everything else, complete, in a collapsed native <details> (Enter or Space on its summary opens it).
    var unit = u === "pct_month" ? P.aMonth : "", norm = D.normalisation[m.norm];
    var val = function (x, c) {
      if (x == null) return P.na;
      if (u === "pct_month") return pc(x);
      if (u === "beta") return bt(x);
      return rsFill(P.count, { k: c, n: n, share: pc(x, 1) });
    };
    var sc = function (x, c) { return x == null ? P.na : fx(x, 2) + (c ? P.clipped : ""); };
    var dt = function (t) { return "<dt>" + esc(t) + "</dt>"; };
    h += '<details class="rs-more"' + (open ? " open" : "") + "><summary>" + esc(P.more) + "</summary><dl>";
    h += dt(P.dStream) + "<dd>" + esc(tx({ en: v.stream.short_en, zh: v.stream.short_zh }) + P.colon) + "<strong>" + esc(val(s, k)) + "</strong>" + esc(unit) + "</dd>";
    h += dt(P.dBench) + "<dd>" + esc(P.bench + P.colon) + "<strong>" + esc(val(b, kb)) + "</strong>" + esc(unit) +
         (m.bench_by_construction ? ' <span class="rs-hint-inline">' + esc(P.conNote) + "</span>" : "") + "</dd>";
    h += dt(P.dState) + "<dd>" + esc(tx(D.state_names[st]) + P.colon + tx(d.rules[st])) + "</dd>";
    h += dt(P.dN) + "<dd" + (small ? ' class="rs-small-n"' : "") + ">" + esc("n = " + n + P.open + rsFill(P.nOf, { n: n, m: v.st.n_months }) + P.close) +
         (small ? " ⚠ " + esc(P.smallTag) : "") + "</dd>";
    h += dt(P.dCalc) + "<dd>" + esc(P.calc[m.norm]) + "</dd>";
    h += dt(rsFill(P.dCi, { lvl: lvl })) + "<dd>" + esc(range) +
         (se != null ? esc(P.open + P.se + " " + (u === "pct_month" ? pc(se) : bt(se)) + P.close) : "") +
         ' <span class="rs-hint-inline">' + esc(P.ciNote) + "</span></dd>";
    h += dt(P.dNorm) + "<dd>" + esc(sc(v.res.score[i], v.res.clipped[i]) + " / " + sc(v.bench.score[i], v.bench.clipped[i])) +
         " · <code>" + esc(norm.formula) + "</code> " + esc(tx(norm)) + "</dd>";
    h += "</dl>";
    if (v.res.clipped[i] || v.bench.clipped[i]) h += '<p class="rs-hint">' + esc(P.clipNote) + "</p>";
    if (m.wp_name) h += '<p class="rs-hint">' + esc(rsFill(P.wpName, { name: m.wp_name })) + "</p>";
    h += '<p class="rs-hint">' + esc(rsFill(P.bandsText, { flat: pc(B.flat), half: pc(B.half, 0), near_lo: pc(B.near[0], 0), near_hi: pc(B.near[1], 0),
                                                            b1: bt(B.beta[0]), b2: bt(B.beta[1]), b3: bt(B.beta[2]), b4: bt(B.beta[3]) })) + "</p>";
    h += "</details>";
    return { q: P.q[m.id], read: read, trust: trust, lead: lead, verdict: code, interp: ic, small: small, html: h };
  }
  /* rs-panel:end */

  function view() { return rsView(D, cur.stream, cur.def, cur.win); }
  function posFor(metric, prof) {
    return metric.id === "downside_reliability" ? prof.pos.downside : metric.id === "tail_reliability" ? prof.pos.tail : null;
  }
  function stateName(s) { return txt(D.state_names[s]); }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ init
  function fill(select, items, label) {
    select.innerHTML = "";
    items.forEach(function (it) {
      var o = document.createElement("option");
      o.value = it.id; o.textContent = label(it);
      select.appendChild(o);
    });
  }
  function init(data) {
    D = data;
    cur.stream = D.meta["default"].stream; cur.def = D.meta["default"].definition; cur.win = D.meta["default"].window;
    el("rs-l-stream").textContent = T.stream; el("rs-l-def").textContent = T.def;
    el("rs-l-mode").textContent = T.mode; el("rs-l-norm").textContent = T.norm; el("rs-l-raw").textContent = T.raw;
    el("rs-csv").textContent = T.csv; el("rs-json").textContent = T.json; el("rs-hintline").textContent = T.hint;
    fill(el("rs-stream"), D.streams, function (s) { return txt({ en: s.short_en, zh: s.short_zh }); });
    fill(el("rs-def"), D.definitions, function (d) { return txt(d); });
    el("rs-stream").value = cur.stream; el("rs-def").value = cur.def;
    el("rs-stream").addEventListener("change", function (e) { cur.stream = e.target.value; render(); });
    el("rs-def").addEventListener("change", function (e) { cur.def = e.target.value; render(); });
    ["rs-mode-norm", "rs-mode-raw"].forEach(function (id) {
      el(id).addEventListener("change", function (e) { if (e.target.checked) { cur.mode = e.target.value; render(); } });
    });
    el("rs-csv").addEventListener("click", downloadCsv);
    el("rs-controls").hidden = false; el("rs-tools").hidden = false;
    var t = null;
    window.addEventListener("resize", function () { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(function () { renderChart(view()); }, 150); });
    render();
  }
  function fail() {
    el("rs-warn").textContent = T.failed;
    el("rs-chart").innerHTML = '<img src="/assets/img/return_state.png" width="1200" height="1000" style="width:100%;height:auto" alt="' +
      esc(LANG === "zh" ? "默认视图雷达图：存档策略（实线）与美国股票基准（虚线）的八项标准化得分；数值见“输出”部分的表格。" :
          "Radar chart of the default view: eight normalised scores for the archived strategy (solid) and the U.S. equity benchmark (dashed); the numbers are in the table under Outputs.") + '">';
    root.setAttribute("data-state", "failed");
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ render
  function render() {
    var v = view();
    renderDataline(v); renderWarnings(v); renderChart(v); renderTable(v); renderDetail(v); renderSummary(v);
    root.setAttribute("data-view", v.key + "|" + cur.mode);
    root.setAttribute("data-state", "ready");
  }
  function renderDataline(v) {
    el("rs-dataline").innerHTML =
      '<span class="wb-date"><strong>' + esc(v.stream.kind === "archived" ? T.data : T.dataPublic) + '</strong></span>' +
      '<span class="wb-date">' + esc(T.built) + esc(longDate(D.meta.built_at)) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="wb-date">' + esc(T.window) + esc(txt(v.win)) + (LANG === "zh" ? "，" : ", ") + v.st.n_months + esc(T.months) + '</span>';
  }
  function renderWarnings(v) {
    var lim = D.meta.small_n, items = [];
    ["normal", "rally", "recovery", "downside", "tail"].forEach(function (s) {
      if (v.st.n[s] < lim) items.push(T.warnSmall(stateName(s), v.st.n[s], lim));
    });
    if (!items.length) items.push(T.warnNone + lim + T.warnNone2);
    var archived = v.stream.kind === "archived";
    if (archived) { items.push(T.warnSelect); items.push(T.warnLoad); items.push(T.warnStable); }
    items.push(T.warnBench);
    if (cur.stream.indexOf("strategy_") === 0) items.push(T.warnLS);
    var k = clipCount(v);
    if (k) items.push(T.warnClip(k));
    items.push(T.warnOverlap(v.st.overlap.rally_recovery));
    if (cur.stream.indexOf("proxy_") === 0) items.push(T.warnProxy);
```
